about: Local cache of support-card event skill hints (Global). One entry per card id. 'chain': [[link, [skill names]]] where the player can pick the skill (choice) or it is the success outcome; 'always': skills given whenever the card is in the deck (pal recreation finales); 'chance': [[skill, probability per run]]; 'disabled': events that do not fire in independent training; 'status': complete | partial | unknown; 'src': where it came from. Skill names must match the in-game Global names (web_skills.json). Add cards here instead of re-fetching sites. 'alts' (written by the builder): events that name two or more skills, in full, [[link, [choice][outcome] -> skill names]]; the solver uses them instead of 'chain' at those links, so skills on different choices or outcomes are never credited together.
